title: Links
description: A link from one task to another, and a link from a task to a page outside the server. Section 3.5 of the protocol.

taskId.description: A project's prefix, a hyphen and a key of lowercase letters and digits, then one .n per level of child task, such as web-a1b2.3.

linkType.description: blocks: the task waits on the other and is not ready until it closes. related: same subject. discovered-from: found from the other's work. duplicates: the same work, filed later. supersedes: replaces the other.

taskLink.description: A link read from the task that has it: the task waits on, relates to, was found from, duplicates or supersedes the task named by id.

externalLink.description: A page outside the server that the work concerns. A task links to a URL once, kept as the URL standard writes it.
